entities.summary: German Empire, a political institution in Germany during German Unification under Bismarck (1862–1871). Grew from Proclamation of the German Empire at Versailles and Vormärz & the 1848 Revolution. Led to the emergence of Kulturkampf and Bismarckian Empire.
